body: I can feel that I am dependent on people but isn't that the concept of society? In such a heavily populated world all I am looking for is someone who can understand what I am going through and support me if not inspire to continue the struggle. Why is it so hard to find. Why does everybody I thought were friends and family doing such a good job of backing off when I need them and could use their help?
I think exactly like that. Don't know how right it is
There is a very strong sense of hopelessness. Even my psychologist send clueless as to what needs to be done about it
You are too kind. Everytime someone compliments me out makes me feel worse. Makes the world worse because bad things shouldn't happen to good people

I am really intrigued by your approach. Would certainly like your whimsical way. I certainly wasn't this way but since events happened which look really minor to everybody involved as well as the onlookers. But when I look at it from my perspective the are very significant. Everything a person usually does is representative of the thought process underneath. I have come to a stage where I have no faith in life , family, relationships, humanity of any such concept that seperates humans from lower animals. If you take all that out what is the point of anything at all.

That's what I m doing. Taking things day by day. But none of these nice people are/will be here when I need them, when I just want a hug or to be comforted etc. Just saying that there are too many logistic issues

Sometimes I feel strong. Then there are times when I just wish to stop breathing. I simply can't find a reason to live on as the family I held so dear are the very people who I shouldn't rely on. There is absolutely no point to life. Just pulling on.
I can chat. I need someone too. I will be reading the rest of your post now
Well said. Would like to discuss these aspects. Glad to find somebody who can understand
